name: chat-widget
title: Chat Widget
description: Website chat built on the shadcn-svelte chat primitives (Message Scroller, Message, Bubble, Marker, Input Group). `ChatWidget` is a floating launcher that opens a non-modal, resizable window (full visible screen on phones, keyboard-aware via visualViewport); `ChatPanel` is the same conversation for embedding in a page. Streams replies through a pluggable `transport` — `createSseTransport()` POSTs to an endpoint and reads server-sent events — with stop, retry, reset, suggestions, a turn limit (only `ChatError` messages reach the visitor, anything else shows a translated fallback) and an optional prebuilt consent step (`requireConsent`: provider, logo and model badge, privacy link, a way out without AI; every part replaceable, `consented` bindable for a consent manager, or replace it entirely with `consentScreen`). `messages`, `draft` and `consented` are bindable; `onSend`, `onReply`, `onError` hooks. Customisable via `accentClass` (gradients too) and per-element classes, icon/header/message snippets, a fully custom `launcher` snippet (or `launcherAnimated={false}`), bubble variants, `position` and default size. Replies are plain text by default — `createLinkifier()` turns only allowlisted paths, email domains or URLs into links — or HTML via `renderHtml` (e.g. markdown; `settlePartialMarkdown()` hides half-arrived syntax while streaming). `reveal="flow"` paces a reply word by word at reading speed, uncovers each word left to right and grows the bubble smoothly; `followReply={false}` keeps the question at the top instead of scrolling after the reply. Transports may yield `{ status }` chunks (e.g. "Searching the docs…") shown in place of the typing label, and `ask(text)` on the widget or panel sends a question from outside the chat.
